# PTX spill ratchet — tools/ptx-spill-check.sh (recipe `just gate-ptx-spill`) holds every entry of
# these binaries to the spill and jit_local bytes pinned here: `spill` is ptxas's spill stores
# (bytes), `jit_local` the driver JIT's local bytes per thread (tools/ptx-scan.sh's columns). The
# check is exact: a value above its pin, below it, an entry the scan prints that has no row, and a
# row whose entry the scan no longer prints are each a failure. A nonzero pin carries a PIN line.
# Pinned from the scans on ptxas 13.3.73, sm_86, JIT on the RTX 3090 with CUDA 13.4.
# The `# arch:` and `# jit-cc:` lines name the one arch and card capability every row pins (tools/ptx-spill-check.sh reads
# each scan against the table of its banner's arch and capability); another pair's rows are a table of their own in
# tools/ref/ptx-shapes/, whose tables the recipe names beside this one.
# PIN(2026-10-21): gate_e2e is no longer a pinned binary. Every one of its rows was a row of generate_ds41 for the same entry
# at the same values: both bins carry the one bloomery-gpu bundle, and tools/check-ptx-names.py holds that premise (every
# device crate gate_e2e links is linked by a scanned binary with the same features, and gate_e2e declares no kernel of its own).
